$comment: Terrain (design doc §9.1) and weather (§9.2). Terrain is per cell; weather is one global condition for the whole battle. Defender-only bonuses use the occupancy rule in §9.3.

terrain.name: Hills / High Ground
terrain.summary: Defender only: ranged +1 Range; melee ATK x1.5 and DEF x1.5.

terrain.name: Woodlands
terrain.summary: Ranged units' effective Range -1 while firing from or into it. No movement penalty.

terrain.name: Heavy Brushland
terrain.summary: Double movement cost; +5 DEF against ranged attacks for units inside. Stacks with woodland.

terrain.name: Impassable Cliffs
terrain.summary: Blocks movement across one full row boundary within a single column, rolled per column.

terrain.name: Swamp
terrain.summary: Double movement cost; defending unit gains +1 DEF per 5 points of its own base DEF.

terrain.name: River / Water's Edge
terrain.summary: Impassable for battle purposes. Fords may later be a passable sub-feature.

weather.name: Fog
weather.summary: Scouting Duel candidate pool reduced from 6 to 4.
